name: Atropal
body:
ATROPAL
CR 25/MR 9

XP 1,638,400
NE Small undead (mythic)
Init +20/+0M, dual initiative MA; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; lifesense 120 ft.; true seeing; Perception +38; Aura dissolution 30 ft. (DC 37), profound desecration 100 ft.

DEFENSE

AC 40 touch 23, flat-footed 32 (+4 deflection, +7 Dex, +1 dodge, +17 natural, +1 size)
hp 598 (27d8+477)
Fort +23, Ref +22, Will +27; second save
DR 20/epic; Immune positive energy, undead traits; SR 40

OFFENSE

Speed fly 80 ft. (perfect)
Melee oblivion touch +29 (20d6+4 plus 1d6 Str, Con, and Dex drain)
Ranged 4 wretched bolts +32 (1d4 negative levels/19–20)
Special Attacks explosive drain, faith consumption (DC 35), mythic power (9/day, surge +1d10), oblivion touch (DC 35), soul feed, wretched bolts
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +31)

Constant–freedom of movement, greater death knell aura (DC 31), true seeing, unholy aura (DC 29)
At Will–animate dead M, circle of death M (DC 31), create greater undead, death knell M (DC 27), desecrate M, finger of deathM (DC 32), disintegrateM (DC 27), greater dispel magic, greater teleport, soul bind, unhallowM
3/day–blasphemyM (DC 28), horrid wilting (DC 32), supreme curse terrain (DC 33), waves of exhaustion
1/day–cursed earth (DC 34), mage’s disjunctionM (DC 30), massacre (DC 34), shades (DC 30), wail of the banshee (DC 34), weird (DC 30), wishM (DC 30)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 25, Con —, Int 24, Wis 27, Cha 33
Base Atk +20; CMB +27; CMD 45
Feats Ability Focus (aura of dissolution), Command UndeadM, Critical FocusM, Flyby Attack, Dodge, Greater Spell Focus (necromancy), Greater Spell Penetration, Improved Critical (wretched bolts), Improved Initiative M, Lightning Reflexes, Spell FocusM (necromancy), Spell Penetration M, Spell Specialization (animate dead), Undead Master
Skills Bluff +41, Diplomacy +41, Intimidate +41, Knowledge (arcana) +37, Knowledge (planes) +37, Knowledge (religion) +37, Perception +38, Sense Motive +38, Spellcraft +37
Languages Necril; telepathy 300 ft.
SQ failed prophet

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura of Dissolution (Su)

An atropal constantly exudes an aura of negative energy which deals 5d6 points of negative energy damage every round to all creatures within 30 feet of the atropal at the beginning of its turn (DC 37 Will save half). Undead in this area (including the atropal) are healed by an equal amount every round.

Rather than healing or harming creatures within the field, an atropal can choose to affect all creatures in the field as if by the Command Undead feat (this includes bonuses from the mythic version of this feat). Any attempts to channel positive energy within the aura of dissolution fail.

Explosive Drain (Su)

Whenever an atropal kills a creature with a death effect, negative energy, or negative levels, that creature explodes in a burst of negative energy. All creatures within 20 feet of the dead creature take 10d6 points of negative energy (DC 35 Will save half). Undead creatures are healed by this damage.

Failed Prophet (Su)

An atropal can have up to 240 HD worth of undead under its control at a time from animate dead. In addition, an atropal can sense through the senses of any undead it has created.

Faith Consumption (Su)

An atropal sustains itself with sundered magic. Whenever a spell fails to bypass an atropal’s spell resistance or the atropal successfully dispels an effect, the profane bonuses from the atropal’s profound desecration are increased by 4 (to +10 and +8) for a number of rounds equal to the level of the spell negated or dispelled. By expending a use of mythic power as an immediate action, an atropal can inflict 2d4 negative levels on a creature which failed to bypass its spell resistance (DC 35 Will save negates).

Oblivion Touch (Su)

An atropal possesses a touch attack which deals 20d6 points of negative energy damage as well as 1d6 points of Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution drain. A successful Fortitude save negates the ability drain (DC 35).

Profound Desecration (Su)

An atropal exudes a powerful aura of negative energy out to 100 feet. The DC to resist negative channeled energy (Including the atropal’s explosive drain and aura of dissolution) within this area gains a +6 profane bonus. Every undead creature in the desecrated area gains a +4 profane bonus on all attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws. An undead creature created which enters or is summoned into such an area gains +4 hit points per HD. Finally, all undead in the area become immune to positive energy. These benefits are already factored into the atropal’s stats.

Soul Feed (Su)

When using its soul bind spell-like ability, an atropal imprisons the target within its body rather than within a gem. For the purpose of freeing a creature, the atropal’s body counts as the soul gem. When a creature dies as a result of the atropal’s greater death knell aura, the creature’s soul is absorbed into the atropal as per soul bind and the atropal gains the benefits of mythic death knell rather than death knell.

Wretched Bolts (Su)

An atropal possesses four ranged touch attacks with a range of 300 feet. Any creature struck by one of these attacks suffers 1d4 negative levels. These negative levels are doubled on a critical hit. Undead creatures struck by a wretched bolt gain 10 temporary hit points.

ABOUT

There are many factors which can cause a god’s birth to fail, among them a lack of dedicated following, an indistinct sense of identity, or a disagreement between the forces granting divinity. Regardless of cause, the stillborn deities known as atropals tend to share ashen and half-formed countenances.

Like a true deity, atropals crave loyalty and metaphysical fixation, but these undead obtain such treasures through the mass reanimation of mindless undead and the ravenous capture of souls.
